name: Golgi vesicle traffic for secretion and lysosomal sorting
rationale: All members concern vesicle budding and traffic through the Golgi (COPI anterograde/retrograde, intra-Golgi, TGN); unlike the confusables, which emphasise endosome-to-Golgi retrieval, this theme carries protein secretion, Golgi-associated and lysosome vesicle biogenesis and lysosomal protein targeting.

name: mRNA deadenylation, decapping and 5'-to-3' decay
rationale: Members cover the poly(A) shortening, decapping, P-body and 5'-3' exonuclease route of mRNA turnover, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on ARE-binding stabilisers/destabilisers, polyadenylation or zygotic maternal-mRNA clearance.

name: Extracellular sequestration of signaling ligands from receptors
rationale: All four members describe holding proteins such as BMP in the extracellular space or matrix to regulate signalling, whereas confusables are downstream BMP/TGF-beta/Wnt signalling, osteogenesis and patterning.

name: HIF hypoxia response, glycolysis and erythroid oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine HIF-alpha oxygen sensing and hypoxia gene programmes with glucose catabolism, plus erythrocyte differentiation and oxygen transport, which the glycolysis-regulation, mTORC1/p53 and gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

name: Atypical-linkage and unanchored polyubiquitin chain assembly
rationale: All members are formation of K6-, K27-, K29-linked or free ubiquitin chains, distinguishing the theme from deubiquitinase and mitophagy confusables.

name: Cullin neddylation and PD-L1 stability in tumor immunity
rationale: Members span neddylation/COP9 deneddylation, cullin-adaptor RHOBTB cycles and cullin-mediated degradation, with a block on PD-L1 glycosylation, degradation and T cell anti-tumour responses that the main neddylation confusable lacks.

name: Chamber myocardium, trabeculation, endocardium and septum morphogenesis
rationale: All members build atrial/ventricular myocardium, trabeculae, endocardium or septa, unlike confusables on early heart tube and second heart field, coronary vessels, or valve/cushion formation.

name: Classical complement activation and its negative regulation
rationale: Members are antibody-triggered classical complement activation and its inhibition, distinguishing the theme from lectin/GZMK and alternative-pathway or positive-regulation confusables.

name: Mucopolysaccharidoses and lysosomal chondroitin, keratan, heparan sulfate degradation
rationale: All members are lysosomal GAG degradation steps or their MPS disorders across CS/DS, KS, HS and hyaluronan, whereas confusables add the heparan-sulfate-only Sanfilippo (MPS III) forms the theme lacks.

qualifier: promotion of long-term plasticity and spine maturation
name: Promotion of long-term synaptic plasticity and spine maturation
rationale: Members positively regulate LTP, LTD, structural plasticity, spine morphogenesis and synapse maturation with local translation and postsynaptic calcium, unlike confusables on reelin/dendrite maintenance, cAMP-CREB or glutamate receptor signalling.

qualifier: pyrimidine and deoxyribonucleotide, de novo and salvage
name: Pyrimidine nucleotide and deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis, de novo and salvage
rationale: Members synthesise UMP/UDP/UTP, CMP, dTTP and deoxyribonucleotides by de novo and salvage routes, distinguishing the theme from interconversion, purine synthesis and pyrimidine catabolism confusables.

core: Extracellular protease cascades and their inhibitors
qualifier: contact system, fibrinolysis and matrix metalloproteases
name: Contact-system, fibrinolytic and matrix metalloprotease cascades and inhibitors
rationale: Members concern FXII-kallikrein-bradykinin contact activation, plasminogen/fibrinolysis, MMP-driven collagen and elastin breakdown and their serpin-type inhibition, unlike confusables centred on the coagulation cascade/VWF or integrin-ECM adhesion.

name: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism, biotin cofactor and organic acidemias
rationale: Members cover leucine/valine/isoleucine breakdown via BCKDH, its MSUD and organic acidemia defects and biotin-dependent carboxylase deficiencies, which the PDH/OGDH, lipoylation and CoA confusables lack.

name: Two-pore-domain and ATP-sensitive K+ channels setting resting potential
rationale: Members are K2P, KATP and Ca2+-activated K+ channels, P-type ion pumps and Na+/K+ homeostasis setting resting potential and excitability, unlike confusables on renal Na+/Mg2+ handling or hair-cell and smooth-muscle physiology.

qualifier: tangential interneuron migration and cortical lamination
name: Cortical interneuron tangential migration, lamination and forebrain regionalization
rationale: Members concern neuron migration, layering, regional specification and neuron-type commitment in cortex, hippocampus and thalamus, unlike confusables on forebrain patterning, spinal cord, or commissures and reelin-driven radial migration.

name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates and cationic amino acids
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of di/tricarboxylates (malate-aspartate shuttle, succinate, citrate) and lysine/arginine/ornithine with their transporter diseases, whereas confusables are glutamate, urea-cycle or carnitine metabolism.

name: Embryonic craniofacial, palate and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members shape face, nose, palate, cranium, limbs and digits from mesenchyme, unlike confusables on pharyngeal organs, inner/outer ear or neural plate and hindbrain patterning.

qualifier: Treg induction over Th17 and effector T cells
name: Treg differentiation and suppression of Th17 and effector T cells
rationale: Members promote regulatory T cell differentiation while restraining Th17 commitment, CD4/CD8 T cell activation and IFN-gamma, unlike confusables on Th1, IL-2/tolerance or dendritic cell-driven T cell activation.

qualifier: endothelial NO synthase activation and trafficking
name: Endothelial NO synthase activation and NO-cGMP vasorelaxation
rationale: Members cover eNOS activation/trafficking, NO-cGMP signalling and vascular smooth muscle relaxation, which blood-pressure, shear-stress and renal confusables lack.

qualifier: NGF via ERK5 and p38 to CREB
name: NGF-induced ERK5 and p38 signaling to CREB-driven transcription
rationale: All four members are the nuclear arm of NGF signalling via ERK5, p38 and CREB phosphorylation, whereas confusables are upstream TRK receptor activation and adaptor signalling.

qualifier: oxygen sensing and glycolytic gene induction
name: Oxygen-sensing HIF hypoxia response and glycolytic gene induction
rationale: Members are HIF-alpha prolyl hydroxylation, HIF-1 target regulation and the hypoxia/glycolysis programmes, distinguishing the theme from NRF2, glycolytic enzyme and mTORC1/p53 metabolic confusables.

core: Renal sodium handling in blood pressure control
name: Aldosterone-responsive renal sodium handling and blood pressure
rationale: Members concern aldosterone response, sodium import, glomerular filtration and renal control of blood volume and pressure, unlike confusables on vasopressin water balance, angiotensin metabolism or aldosterone synthesis.

qualifier: calcium-activated, with blebbing and cell shrinkage
name: Calcium-activated phospholipid scrambling, membrane blebbing and cell volume
rationale: Members are Ca2+-activated (ANO6-type) phospholipid scrambling with membrane blebbing and cell volume decrease, unlike confusables on apoptotic-cell clearance, flippases or ER lipid transfer.

name: MHC class I antigen processing, loading and cross-presentation
rationale: Members cover proteasomal antigen generation, ER transport and class I peptide loading, including endosomal and phagosomal cross-presentation, unlike confusables on proteasome assembly, Nef downregulation or MHC class II.

name: Monocyte surface receptors and CD1 lipid antigen presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte surface/receptor modules, monocyte differentiation and CD1-mediated lipid antigen presentation, which separate the theme from neutrophil-myeloid, resting DC and TLR7 confusables.
